title: Rolling deprecation with lighthouse customers and gated upgrade path
creator: Asha Menon
description: Objective: retire legacy inference API v1 while minimizing customer disruption by using a controlled, rolling deprecation. Strategy combines 'lighthouse' customer cohorts (early, hand-holding migrations), a gated upgrade path enforced at the routing layer, and cross-team coordinated comms + release notes. Deliverables: migration kit, migration CLI snippets, commercs cadence, release notes templates, support runbooks, success metrics and rollback criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Migration kit published with step-by-step guides and code snippets for SDK and REST clients
At least 5 lighthouse customers onboarded and migrated successfully with CS signoff
Gated routing policy implemented and tested in staging + canary environments
Release notes and comms templates reviewed and signed off by Legal, Security, and Support
Support runbook published and on-call engineers trained with simulated migration playthrough
Rollback and emergency mitigation steps documented and validated in a dry-run
timeline: 2026-02-15: Engineering spike for gated routing prototypes (completed)
2026-03-10: Stakeholder review and Legal/Sec signoff (in progress)
2026-04-05: Expand to open cohorts + broad comms (phase 2)
2026-04-15: Target date to begin automated deprecation enforcement for remaining customers
rollout_steps: Step 0: Finalize routing policy and compatibility matrix (ENG)
Step 1: Publish migration kit + example PRs and SDK snippets (PM + DX)
Step 2: Invite lighthouse customers, schedule migration windows, provide dedicated CS/SE support (CS/SE)
Step 3: Execute gated migration for lighthouse cohort; monitor latency/error/quality metrics in real time (Eng/Observability)
Step 4: Collect feedback, fix issues, update docs and release notes (PM/Eng/Design)
Step 5: Open migration to opt-in customer base with clear deadlines and incentive (PM/GTM)
Step 6: Gradually increase enforcement thresholds until full deprecation cutover (runtime routing + rate-limits)
comms_plan: Pre-announcement (internal): 2 weeks before public comms - engineering, sales, support, legal briefing
Public announcement via blog post + customer portal with migration timeline and FAQ
Targeted emails to lighthouse cohort with onboarding calendar and dedicated contact
Release notes: concise migration checklist, breaking changes, code diffs, SDK upgrade examples
Weekly migration status updates for customers during active phases
Escalation playbook: one-pager for CSMs to triage high-impact migrations
release_notes_draft:
Deprecation Notice: Legacy Inference API v1

We are retiring the Legacy Inference API v1 to focus on a unified, faster, and more secure API surface. Customers should migrate to the v2-compatible endpoints. Key changes: updated authentication headers, new default batching behavior, and stricter schema validation for structured outputs. Migration: follow the migration kit (link), update SDK to >= 2.4.0, and test against the compatibility test harness. We will provide dedicated support windows for lighthouse customers and a 60-day opt-in migration window before automated enforcement begins. See detailed timeline and rollback guarantees in the portal.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Unexpected breaking behavior in high-throughput workloads. Mitigation: stage gated policy and KV cache compatibility tests; run load tests with two lighthouse customers before phase 2.
Risk: Incomplete customer awareness leading to support surge. Mitigation: multi-channel comms, clear migration checklist, prioritized support triage for lighthouse customers.
Risk: Security or compliance blockers discovered late. Mitigation: early Legal/Sec review during draft release notes and CI gating for KMS usage patterns.
Risk: Rollback complexity if automated enforcement causes outages. Mitigation: keep manual override controls and documented emergency rollback steps; rehearse during dry-run.
analytics_and_success_metrics: % of active customers migrated to v2 by 2026-04-15
Average error rate delta pre/post migration for lighthouse cohort (<0.2% target)
Mean p95 latency difference across endpoints (target <5% regression)
Number of migration-related support tickets per 100 customers (target <3)
Post-migration satisfaction score from lighthouse customers (>4.0/5)
Time-to-rollback when emergency cutoff initiated (<15 minutes)
